hazards.text: Charges a single lithium-ion / lithium-polymer cell with up to 1.5 A: overcharge, a wrong R_ISET, a short circuit or a damaged cell can cause fire. Use a protected cell with a 10 kΩ NTC on TS, set R_ISET for the cell's rated charge current, never charge unattended or near flammable material.
